name: App builder — idea to launch
description: An idea becomes a running app, staffed like a company. DISCOVERY: the product-manager writes requirements → the CTO designs the architecture (reading your workspace) → a kickoff panel (growth + finance in parallel, devil's advocate attacking them) → the frontend-designer writes the design spec → the content-strategist brands it → YOUR sign-off. BUILD — engineers, not validators: the backend-engineer persona builds the database layer, then the backend API, the frontend-engineer persona builds the UI to the design spec — each layer with its own unit tests — then the full suite runs and the on-call engineer fixes-and-retests until green. Build steps run on the delegation IDLE timeout (a long ACTIVE build is never killed at a wall-clock; set a node timeout to cap one). REVIEW: one agent per area (backend+db, frontend vs the design spec, ops) compiled into a quality report and saved. LAUNCH MEETING: PM and devops each cast a GO/NO-GO vote, a chair compiles the decision, minutes are saved on one branch while the other routes the verdict — 🚀 GO or 🛑 NO-GO notification. Pair with “App builder — iteration” to keep developing afterwards. Build steps use the ✎ write tier; the fix loop is bounded by the run's visit cap (cancel from the jobs popup if it thrashes).
